Who was the best 22 year old in NBA history?

The NBA has really not gotten THAT much better over the decades. The rules have simply changed.

Since the 80’s the athleticism and skill level has not really changed that much. It’s a massive overstatement made by children that want to believe all their favorite players that they grew up watching are the best to ever do it.

The rules have changed completely, things that were a double dribble or a travel back then are normal moves now. Players have gotten better at shooting 3’s

The game looks different from what it used to, so when these teenagers go back and watch 70’s, 80’s, or 90’s basketball it looks like the players suck, when in reality they were just playing with a completely different set of rules.

Any player that is an all time great would be an all timer in ANY ERA of basketball.

It’s not just how good they are/were at a certain thing that made them great. It’s their insane drive to be the best combined with extreme natural talent and IQ.

Bill Russel/Wilt are great in any era
Magic/Kareem are great in any era
Mike/Bird are great in any era
Shaq/Kobe are great in any era
Lebron/Curry are great in any era

People not caring until the end and casually watching the finals shouldn’t happen.

Why James Harden is less effective in the playoffs?

My theory: the foul calls he gets during the regular season dry up in the playoffs.

Refs call fouls in playoff games more discerningly, for the most part. In particular, baiting fouls seem to be called less.

When Harden can’t feast on these, he scores less from the line. Additionally, other teams learn that they can defend him tighter without getting whistled, so he has to work harder to score from the field.

The data seems to back this up: below are his FTA in the regular season vs the playoffs for the last 10 years:

24-25: 7.3 / 4.7
23-24: 4.8 / 5.3
22-23: 6.2 / 5.0
21-22: 8.2 / 6.3
20-21: 7.3 / 6.9
19-20: 11.8 / 9.7
18-19: 11.0 / 8.9
17-18: 10.1 / 7.8
16-17: 10.9 / 10.5
15-16: 10.2 / 9.0

What if hand checking came back

In today’s game, where scoring is so widespread and comes from further out, what do you think allowing hand checking would do to the game? It obviously had a huge impact of scoring when it got banned, but it’s a completely different game now. I kinda feel like it may bring a little balance back and give defenses just a little more of an ability to guard in a time where defense is so much more difficult, but wouldn’t dampen scoring a ton. So your thoughts. Leave everything as is but bring back hand checking? Yeah or nay?
